title: Bounded finite cone blocks
statement: If every E_k is bounded above, every finite cone block C_n [def-sc-compact-flat-telescope-blocks] is bounded above.

source.place: The source-bar, finite-cone-block, least-block adjunction and union-bar paragraphs; Bounded finite cone blocks.

proof.text: Inductively take the maximum of the upper bounds of E_0 through E_(n+1). The two finite coproducts vanish above that bound. The mapping-cone term consists of the domain term in degree i+1 and codomain term in degree i, so it too vanishes above that bound.
